meta.doc:
Arena ratings: one 1-99 rating per player in supabase/functions/fans/squads.json -> data/arena-ratings.json.
Run: python3 -I tools/arena_ratings.py [--resume|--rescore]   (free public sources only, no keys; ~70 polite requests, ~2 min)

Methods (never EA/FIFA/FM ratings, never invented stats):
 One scale for all methods: a regular starter lands around 72-88, 90+ is rare.
 fpl       Premier League clubs. FPL bootstrap-static, current season, compared only within the player's FPL position
           against that position's regulars (>= 30% of the minutes played so far, all 20 PL teams):
           q = 0.55*pct(now_cost) + 0.25*pct(output per 90) + 0.20*min(1, minutes / (finished gameweeks*90)); rating = 64 + 27*q.
           output: GK clean sheets + saves/10; DEF clean sheets + defensive contribution/10; MID xGI + defensive contribution/30;
           FWD xGI. Under 30% of the minutes = output 0 (small samples). pct = share of regulars below him (0..1).
           available = FPL status a/d and chance_of_playing >= 50 (or null).
 wiki      Other clubs, player has an English Wikipedia infobox. apps = senior club caps summed over the infobox (II/B/reserve
           sides skipped), caps = most caps for one senior national team.
           rating = 50 + 12*tier + 18*sqrt(min(1, apps/500)) + 10*min(1, caps/100).
 baseline  Other clubs, no parsable infobox: rating = 56 + 12*tier (a fringe player of that club's level).
 tier      a league-level weight (TIER below). It is an assumption, not a stat; the owner may change it.
--rescore  re-applies the formulas to the Wikipedia stats already in the file (FPL is always fetched fresh).
available is null for non-PL clubs: there is no free injury feed for them.
